components.name: Sign-in flow
components.description: OIDC authorization code with PKCE, state and nonce; creates, refreshes and revokes cookie sessions (Secure, HttpOnly). Keeps the guest claim proof flow in the same tab.

components.name: API forwarding
components.description: Checks the session cookie and CSRF on mutations, then forwards the bearer token (none on guest create) to Link, Account and Billing APIs. Refreshes tokens with Identity.

components.name: Sign-in
components.description: Optional: guest create sends no token and is anonymous; an invalid or expired token is 401. Owner, claim and operator routes still check the verified subject.

components.name: Link operations
components.description: Create (guest or owned) with CSPRNG slugs, idempotency keys and admission; claim with one-time proof; If-Match edits; tombstone deletes. Reputation check and entitlement grant first.

components.name: Abuse and moderation
components.description: Bounded public abuse reports (202, no disposition shown) and block or unblock under a separate operator permission. A report alone never disables a link.

components.name: Resolve and redirect
components.description: Host + slug via Hot routes, else the Links public view; state and expiry; publish the click and await its ACK; recheck; then 302 with no-store. Otherwise 404/410/403, or 503 with no Location.

components.name: Sign-in
components.description: Required: every route needs a valid token. Each query is scoped to the verified subject, cursors included.

components.name: My links
components.description: Cursor pages (at most 50, by created_at and id) of the caller's own links from the Links owner view.

components.name: Link analytics
components.description: Owner-only counts, ranges, freshness and bounded CSV export. Checks ownership in the Links owner view and the tier's lookback and export allowance with Billing API.

components.name: Sign-in
components.description: Optional, so Stripe reaches the webhook without a token. Customer routes still require a signed-in owner; the webhook is authorized by its Stripe signature instead.

components.name: Customer billing
components.description: Signed-in owner only: plan status, hosted Checkout and portal sessions from allowlisted prices, allowed return URLs and idempotency keys. CSRF is checked by Session API.

components.name: Payment events
components.description: No session: verifies the Stripe signature over the raw body bytes, stores the event in the inbox before 2xx, then reconciles subscriptions from Stripe under a lease.

components.name: Entitlements
components.description: Entitlement grants valid for at most 60 seconds, for Link API and Account API only. Fails closed for paid-gated operations when no valid grant exists.

components.name: Click aggregator
components.description: Validates and deduplicates each click event within a bounded horizon, updates aggregates and acknowledges after commit. Poison events go to quarantine, never dropped.
